items.source: Both @SendTo and @SendToUser may be used on the same method in which case a message is sent to the destinations of both annotations.
items.translation: @SendTo 和 @SendToUser 可以应用于同一方法，在这种情况下，消息将发送到这两个注解指定的目的地。

items.source: This annotation may be placed class-level in which case it is inherited by methods of the class. At the same time, method-level @SendTo or @SendToUser annotations override any such at the class level.
items.translation: 此注解可置于类级别，此时该类的方法将继承该注解。同时，方法级别的 `@SendTo` 或 `@SendToUser` 注解会覆盖任何此类类级别的注解。

items.source: By default, this is set to true in which case messages are broadcast to all sessions.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为true，此时消息将广播到所有会话。

items.source:
If left unspecified, a default destination is selected based on the
destination of the input message being handled.
items.translation: 如果未指定，则根据正在处理的输入消息的目的地选择默认目的地。

items.source:
Whether messages should be sent to all sessions associated with the user
or only to the session of the input message being handled.
items.translation: 消息是发送到与该用户关联的所有会话，还是仅发送到正在处理的输入消息的会话。

items.source: One or more destinations to send a message to.
items.translation: 一个或多个要发送消息的目标。
